context:
Goal: your feedback inbox holds only what you said, so no session stops to file an agent's report as your words.
Problem (rule): decision owner-feedback-inbox already says agent text is never captured, yet agent hand-backs land in the inbox (three times in two days); each fix changes how that rule is enforced.
Based on (read): decision owner-feedback-inbox: agent text is never captured.
Based on (measured): hand-backs captured in lanes page-answer-send, c104 and roadmap-matches-lanes (Oct 30) and twice in the coordinator (Oct 31 15:10 CDT).
holds: Lane inbox-saves-agent-reports is paused until you pick.

options.gain: Matches the ruling as written; a small change.
options.how: Add the agent-message block tag to the inbox's skip list in hooks/local_time.py.
options.label: Skip the agent-message tag
options.lose: An agent report that arrives without that tag still gets in.

options.how: As (a), and every brief asks the agent to start its report with a marker line the inbox also skips.
options.label: Skip the tag, plus a marker in every brief
options.lose: One more line in every brief, and a forgotten marker still gets in.

options.gain: Nothing is lost, and the guard stops nagging about agent text.
options.how: The inbox keeps everything but marks each entry as owner or agent, and the guard asks only about owner entries.
options.label: Tag each entry by source
options.lose: A bigger change, and it departs from the ruling's 'never captured'.

options.how: Keep jotting agent reports by hand.
options.label: No change
options.lose: Sessions keep stopping to file agent reports as yours.

ref: inbox-saves-agent-reports (the feedback inbox skips agent hand-backs); decision owner-feedback-inbox
title: How should your feedback inbox keep out agents' reports?
why: It matches your existing ruling with the smallest change; add the marker only if untagged reports still get in.
